summary: Unitil Corporation filed a Form 8-K reporting its September 24, 2026 entry into a Note Purchase Agreement with CoBank, ACB, Thrivent Financial for Lutherans, MetLife Reinsurance Company of Hamilton, Ltd., Modern Woodmen of America and CMFG Life Insurance Company. The Company issued $27 million of 5.42% Senior Unsecured Notes, Series 2026A, due September 24, 2031, and $33 million of 5.79% Senior Unsecured Notes, Series 2026B, due September 24, 2036, for $60 million total. Net proceeds fund utility subsidiary capital contributions, refinance existing debt and general corporate purposes. The private placement under Section 4(a)(2) is a routine debt financing, not a special situation; watch leverage and interest coverage.
